summary: ansible-builder normally pulls from automation hub or Galaxy, PyPI, RHEL/UBI repos and registry.redhat.io, so disconnected builds need those mirrored (private hub, a PyPI mirror such as Nexus, disconnected Satellite); ee-minimal-rhel8 ships in the bundled installer.
questions: How do I build an execution environment in a disconnected environment?
What does ansible-builder download from the internet?
Where do I get the base image offline?
